LanguageData.RatkinQL_MournerTree_Report: A ratkin with a heavy look in his eyes approaches your settlement. He carries news of the dead.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Mourner_Greeting: “{Interviewer_labelShort}… I’ve come a long way to bring word. There are kin who won’t see another dawn. I ask only that you remember them.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Mourner_Loss1: “A Warlord’s band came through a burrow three nights east. They didn’t come for territory. They came because the grain was dry and the tunnels were quiet. No one left alive to tell the full story.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Mourner_Loss2: “The deep tunnels collapsed near the old aquifer. A whole clan was below — the scouts found only a wall of stone and silence. The elders say the earth claimed its own.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Mourner_Loss3: “The surface sickness found its way into the migrant camp. It started with a cough and ended with a pyre. We buried what we could, but the names are already fading.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Mourner_Farewell: The mourner bows his head, grips his staff, and turns without another word. His steps are slow, heavy.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Mourner_MsgDonate: He takes the silver with both hands, presses it to his chest, then bows deeply. “The dead will remember your kindness in the deep earth.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Mourner_MsgCondolence: He listens, eyes reddening. For a long moment he says nothing, then gives a single, silent nod.
